2609.35504.title: SolveEdit: Benchmarking Visual Problem Solving in Generative Models
2609.35504.paper_summary: Machine intelligence is often evaluated through abstract reasoning problems, yet many real-world problems are visual, such as arranging objects, repairing layouts, or tracing routes. Solving these problems requires understanding a scene, inferring what must change to achieve a goal, and realizing that change without disturbing unrelated content. However, existing benchmarks mainly evaluate perception, generation, or explicitly specified transformations, leaving goal-driven visual problem solving underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce SolveEpIT, a benchmark for visual problem solving through scene transformation. Given an image and a goal, a model must infer a valid transformation from the request, the scene, or a visually expressed rule, then execute it while preserving unrelated content. SoLvEEDrr contains 2,728 cases. Atomic transition contracts specify required and protected conditions, enabling SoLvEScoRE to measure completion and unintended changes without a single reference output. The strongest evaluated model achieves only57.0% SolvEScore. We further introduce SolveEdiT-PLAN, a two-stage visual planner that instantiates the transition before generation. Under matched single-generation evaluation, it improves SoLvEScoRE by 9.1 points on average across three tested generators, including a gain from 57.0% to 71.6% for GPT-Image-2, without modifying the editor.
2609.35504.paper_summary_zh: 機器智慧通常通過抽象推理問題來評估，但許多現實世界的問題是視覺性的，例如排列物體、修復佈局或追蹤路徑。解決這些問題需要理解場景、推斷為了達成目標必須改變的內容，並在不干擾無關內容的情況下實現這一變化。然而，現有的基準主要評估感知、生成或明確指定的轉換，將以目標為驅動的視覺問題解決置於未被充分探索的狀態。為了填補這一空白，我們引入了SolveEpIT，一個通過場景轉換進行視覺問題解決的基準。給定一幅圖像和一個目標，模型必須從請求、場景或視覺表達的規則中推斷出有效的轉換，然後在保留無關內容的情況下執行它。SoLvEEDrr包含2,728個案例。原子轉換合約指定所需和受保護的條件，使SoLvEScoRE能夠在沒有單一參考輸出的情況下測量完成度和意外變化。經評估的最強模型僅達到57.0%的SolvEScore。我們進一步引入了SolveEdiT-PLAN，一個兩階段的視覺規劃器，在生成之前實例化轉換。在匹配的單一生成評估下，它平均提高了三個測試生成器的SoLvEScoRE 9.1分，包括GPT-Image-2從57.0%提升至71.6%的增益，且未修改編輯器。
